thread:
maria: Quick design review: allocation pill semantics + rollback indicator. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/rollout-console?node-id=88. Trying to lock copy + a11y before we freeze visuals for the next minor. ashok: Main concern is semantic order for screen readers. If SR reads '(Release > Variant) 50%' without context its confusing. Suggest pill keep '50%' visually but supply aria-label='50% traffic to Variant A'. kai: Visuals: current pill uses 11px text, 8px vertical padding, color #6C6CFF on white. Contrast fails for small text. Recommend bump to 12px or adjust color to meet 4.5:1 for body text. jess: Product note: telemetry uses term 'traffic allocation'. UX should map to that phrase somewhere. But we don't want the crumb to be verbosely long. tim: Implementation idea: leave crumb terse, pill shows '50%'. Pill has role='status' or role='text'? We should avoid button semantics. Also keyboard focus must land on the link not the pill. maria: Proposed copy variants: A) breadcrumb: 'Release v12 › Variant A — 50% traffic' B) breadcrumbs: 'Release v12 › Variant A' plus pill '50%' with aria-label '50% traffic (canary)'. I'm leaning to B for compactness. ashok: +1 B. For SR, aria-label needed. Also add aria-describedby linking the pill to a small offscreen explanation like 'Allocation is percentage of user traffic routed to this variant.' a11y-bot: Color scan: #6C6CFF on #FFFFFF = 2.7:1 (fails AA small). Alternatives: #3F3FD9 = 4.7:1 or add 1px subtle outline + increased padding. Also note keyboard focus indicator must be at least 2px wide and visible against background. kai: Also for colorblind users the pill fill shouldn't be the only indicator. Add a subtle diagonal pattern or an icon for variants? That might be heavy though. Maybe a 1px left border with variant color in addition to fill. jess: Rollback indicator: current icon is a red chevron that sits next to the variant name and currently looks actionable. Users assume they can click it. It should be clearly informational unless we build a rollback workflow here. tim: Technical note: make it role='img' with aria-label='Rollback suggested' and cursor: default. If we ever make it actionable, swap to button with appropriate aria-pressed/state. maria: For live updates when allocation changes (automation), do we announce? I propose aria-live='polite' in the status bar and debounce 2s to avoid spammy reads. ashok: Also plan to add a tiny changelog tooltip on hover: "Increased to 50% at 12:34 UTC by automation" — but ensure tooltip content is present in DOM for SRs (aria-describedby). natalie: (joining late) tiny nit: use 'allocation' everywhere in admin console, but 'traffic' in end-user docs. Keep consistent within product. jess: Good call. Within console we use 'allocation'. In public docs we map to 'traffic'. maria: Action items: 1) I'll update Figma frames (88/89) to show pill at 12px, alt color #3F3FD9, and add offscreen helper copy. 2) tim will draft PR snippet with aria-labels/aria-live/debounce. 3) kai + ashok to run contrast and colorblind permutations. 4) jess will confirm copy alignment for console vs docs. Target: ship in next minor. tim: Sample snippet for PR: ```
  1. Release v12
  2. Variant A 50% Allocation is percent of user traffic routed to the variant.
``` kai: I'll post the contrast matrix here by EOD. ashok: I'll prototype the subtle border + pattern option and post screenshots. jess: OK lock target next minor. Thanks folks. maria: Thanks everyone — will update Figma and drop final copy here when ready. :thumbsup:
